blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Thousands of Filipinos braved the sweltering heat to visit their departed loved ones at the Manila North and South Cemeteries on Sunday as crowds gathered for All Saints’ Day. At the cemeteries, visitors sought relief from the heat by staying under trees, using umbrellas, fanning themselves or covering their heads with towels. According to the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration, the heat index in Manila reached 36 to 38 degrees Celsius by noon.
